snapshot.text: Public system with social health insurance, facing workforce shortages and a high burden of noncommunicable disease. The government plans large pay rises for health workers and a new NCD action plan.

priorities.title: 75% pay rise for health workers
priorities.text: Health workers' pay is to rise 75% in staged increases.

priorities.title: Medicines quality
priorities.text: A National Reference Laboratory for Medicines opened in June 2026.
